determine_add_candidates.template:
WITH latest_stages AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT h.symbol, ss.trading_signal, ss.stage_score
FROM portfolio.holdings h
JOIN latest_stages ss ON h.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY ss.stage_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

determine_trim_candidates.template:
WITH latest_stages AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT h.symbol, ss.trading_signal, ss.stage_score
FROM portfolio.holdings h
JOIN latest_stages ss ON h.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE ss.trading_signal = 'SELL'
ORDER BY ss.stage_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
